g.title: other
g.text: register the hooks where the harness has them

g.title: link
g.text: and asks the developer to confirm the authority remote
(origin proposed, never assumed); only it gets refs/cairn/*

g.title: nohooks
g.text: No hook system: Cairn is instruction-only;
the working agreement is the whole enforcement

g.title: addpath
g.text: Say so; the developer adds it

g.title: choose
g.text: /new-project for software that does not exist

g.title: done
g.text: Done: the command resolves and helps;
the hooks are registered where the harness has them;
